learning_context.basic:
You are given a dialogue transcript (or a portion of it) from an educational activity. Your task is to identify the learning context, defined as the social and instructional setup in which the interaction occurs.

nDialogue:
{INPUT_DIALOGUE}

Choose exactly one of the following categories:
A) classroom instruction — a teacher addressing a whole class or leading a lesson
B) Tutoring — one-on-one guidance between a tutor/teacher and a student
C) Collaborative Group Activity — multiple participants (e.g., students) working together as peers

Output Requirements:
- Return only the corresponding letter (A, B, or C)
- Do not include any explanation, reasoning, or additional text

comm_modality.basic:
You are given a dialogue transcript (or a portion of it) from an educational activity. Your task is to identify the communication modality, defined as the medium and temporal format through which the instructional interaction occurs.

Dialogue:
{INPUT_DIALOGUE}

Choose exactly one of the following categories:
A) in-person — participants are physically co-present
B) synchronous online spoken — real-time spoken interaction via audio/video (e.g., Zoom call)
C) synchronous text-based chat — real-time written exchange (e.g., live chat, messaging)
D) asynchronous online communication — delayed written interaction (e.g., forum posts, emails)

Output Requirements:
- Return only the corresponding letter (A, B, C, or D)
- Do not include any explanation, reasoning, or additional text

edu_level.basic:
You are given a dialogue transcript (or a portion of it) from an educational activity. Your task is to identify the educational level, defined as the stage of formal education associated with the learning interaction.

Dialogue:
{INPUT_DIALOGUE}

Based on the dialogue above, choose exactly one of the following categories:
A) primary — early/basic education (typically elementary school)
B) middle — middle school or early secondary education
C) high — advanced secondary education (e.g., high school)
D) university — higher education (e.g., college, undergraduate, graduate)

Output Requirements:
- Return only the corresponding letter (A, B, C, or D)
- Do not include any explanation, reasoning, or additional text
